comment: F-2 Round 27 — restore approval/executor/artifact full workflows. Spec authority: backup-restore/restore-workflows.md (multi-admin approval, executor state machine, artifact upload+verify+download). Builds on F-1 (round 25/26) which covered the chain smoke. F-2 covers: 2-of-2 multi-admin approval; executor restart-survival (stage persists across crash); artifact upload + integrity verification + download.

encoder.approval_threshold_form: k-of-n with k>=2 for high-risk restores (default 2-of-2)

vectors.name: two_of_two_multi_admin_approval_unblocks_restore
vectors.comment: Restore proposal needs 2-of-2 admin approvals. After admin_a approves, ticket stays in approving state. After admin_b approves, ticket transitions to approved → executor can pick it up.

expected.rationale: k-of-n approval gate: ticket transitions to approved exactly when k-th distinct admin signs.

vectors.name: two_of_two_duplicate_admin_approval_does_not_count_twice
vectors.comment: Negative — admin_a tries to approve twice. The second signature is deduped (same DID); ticket does not transition to approved.

expected.rationale: Distinct-admin gate: same DID twice does not satisfy k>=2.

vectors.name: executor_restart_survival_resumes_from_persisted_stage
vectors.comment: Executor crashes mid-run. On restart, executor reads persisted stage from durable store and resumes from it — does NOT restart from queued.

expected.rationale: Executor stage + progress are durably persisted; restart resumes from the last checkpoint.

vectors.name: artifact_upload_verify_then_download_round_trip
vectors.comment: Restore artifact uploaded by executor; integrity hash verified; client downloads. End-to-end round trip exercises upload → verify → download lifecycle.

expected.rationale: Artifact lifecycle: uploaded → verified → available → downloaded. Each event is durable; integrity is required before download is allowed.

vectors.name: artifact_integrity_mismatch_blocks_download
vectors.comment: Negative — executor uploads artifact whose hash mismatches expected. Download endpoint refuses; ticket transitions to failed; client must re-request from a fresh executor run.

expected.rationale: Integrity mismatch is fatal — never serve a corrupted artifact.
